1a58ea8ddede35e6c7bf9ed6ff391db116c3d947.code:
app [main!] {
    pf: platform "https://github.com/roc-lang/basic-cli/releases/download/0.20.0/X73hGh05nNTkDHU06FHC0YfFaQB1pimX7gncRcao5mU.tar.br",
}
import pf.Stdout
import pf.Arg exposing [Arg]
argument : List Arg -> U64
argument = |args|
    arg = (List.get(args, 1) |> Result.map_ok(Arg.display)) ?? "0"
    Str.to_u64(arg) ?? 0
Tree : [Node U64 Tree Tree, Empty]

build = |depth, identity|
    if depth == 0 then Node(identity,Empty,Empty) else
        Node(identity,build(depth-1,identity*2),build(depth-1,identity*2+1))
check = |tree|
    when tree is
        Empty -> 0u64
        Node(_,left,right) -> 1+check(left)+check(right)
temporary = |remaining, depth, total|
    if remaining == 0 then total else
        temporary(remaining-1,depth,total+check(build(depth,remaining)))
depths = |depth, maximum, output|
    if depth > maximum then output else
        iterations = Num.pow_int(2u64,maximum-depth+4)
        total = temporary(iterations,depth,0)
        line = "${Num.to_str(iterations)}\t trees of depth ${Num.to_str(depth)}\t check: ${Num.to_str(total)}\n"
        depths(depth+2,maximum,Str.concat(output,line))
main! : List Arg => Result {} _
main! = |args|
    maximum = Num.max(6,argument(args))
    stretch = check(build(maximum+1,1))
    long_lived = build(maximum,1)
    rows = depths(4,maximum,"")
    retained = check(long_lived)
    Stdout.write!("stretch tree of depth ${Num.to_str(maximum+1)}\t check: ${Num.to_str(stretch)}\n${rows}long lived tree of depth ${Num.to_str(maximum)}\t check: ${Num.to_str(retained)}\n")

import pf.Stdout
import pf.Arg exposing [Arg]
argument : List Arg -> U64
argument = |args|
    arg = (List.get(args, 1) |> Result.map_ok(Arg.display)) ?? "0"
    Str.to_u64(arg) ?? 0
get = |items, index|
    when List.get(items,index) is
        Ok(value) -> value
        Err(_) -> crash("index out of bounds")
reverse_prefix = |items, first, last|
    if first >= last then items else reverse_prefix(List.swap(items,first,last),first+1,last-1)
flips = |items, total|
    first = get(items,0)
    if first == 0 then total else flips(reverse_prefix(items,0,first),total+1)
rotate = |items, first, i, rank|
    if i == rank then List.set(items,rank,first) else
        value = get(items,i+1)
        rotate(List.set(items,i,value),first,i+1,rank)
prepare = |rank, counts|
    if rank <= 1 then counts else prepare(rank-1,List.set(counts,rank-1,rank))
next = |n, rank, items, counts|
    if rank == n then Finished else
        first = get(items,0)
        rotated = rotate(items,first,0,rank)
        remaining = get(counts,rank)-1
        updated = List.set(counts,rank,remaining)
        if remaining > 0 then Next(rotated,updated,rank) else next(n,rank+1,rotated,updated)
enumerate = |n, items, counts, rank, index, checksum, maximum|
    prepared = prepare(rank,counts)
    current : I64
    current = flips(items,0)
    total = checksum+(if Num.is_even(index) then current else -current)
    largest = Num.max(maximum,current)
    when next(n,1,items,prepared) is
        Finished -> "${Num.to_str(total)}\nPfannkuchen(${Num.to_str(n)}) = ${Num.to_str(largest)}\n"
        Next(perm,cs,r) -> enumerate(n,perm,cs,r,index+1,total,largest)
main! : List Arg => Result {} _
main! = |args|
    n = argument(args)
    output = enumerate(n,List.range({start:At(0u64),end:Before(n)}),List.repeat(0u64,n),n,0u64,0i64,0i64)
    Stdout.write!(output)

fixed : F64, U64 -> Str
fixed = |value, places|
    factor = Num.pow_int(10u64, places)
    scaled : U64
    scaled = Num.round(Num.abs(value) * Num.to_f64(factor))
    whole = scaled // factor
    digits = Num.to_str(scaled % factor)
    padding = Str.repeat("0", places - Str.count_utf8_bytes(digits))
    sign = if value < 0 then "-" else ""
    "${sign}${Num.to_str(whole)}.${padding}${digits}"
code = |byte|
    when byte is
        67 | 99 -> 1u64
        71 | 103 -> 2u64
        84 | 116 -> 3u64
        _ -> 0u64
encode = |text| List.walk(Str.to_utf8(text),0u64,|key,byte| key*4+code(byte))
decode = |width, key, bytes|
    if width == 0 then Str.from_utf8_lossy(List.reverse(bytes)) else
        char = get([65u8,67,71,84],key%4)
        decode(width-1,key//4,List.append(bytes,char))
counts = |width, bytes|
    mask = Num.pow_int(4u64,width)-1
    (_,result) = List.walk_with_index(bytes,(0u64,Dict.empty({})),|state,byte,index|
        (key,table) = state
        next_key = Num.bitwise_and(key*4+Num.to_u64(byte),mask)
        updated = if index+1 >= width then
            Dict.update(table,next_key,|previous| Ok((previous ?? 0)+1))
        else table
        (next_key,updated),
    )
    result
frequencies = |width, bytes|
    entries = Dict.to_list(counts(width,bytes))
    sorted = List.sort_with(entries,|a,b|
        (ka,ca) = a
        (kb,cb) = b
        if ca == cb then Num.compare(ka,kb) else Num.compare(cb,ca),
    )
    denominator = Num.to_f64(List.len(bytes)-width+1)
    rows = List.map(sorted,|pair|
        (key,total) = pair
        "${decode(width,key,[])} ${fixed(100*Num.to_f64(total)/denominator,3)}\n",
    )
    Str.concat(Str.join_with(rows,""),"\n")
main! : List Arg => Result {} _
main! = |_args|
    raw = Stdin.read_to_end!({})?
    text = Str.from_utf8_lossy(raw)
    record = (Str.split_first(text,">THREE") |> Result.map_ok(|x| x.after)) ?? ""
    rest = (Str.split_first(record,"\n") |> Result.map_ok(|x| x.after)) ?? ""
    sequence = (Str.split_first(rest,">") |> Result.map_ok(|x| x.before)) ?? rest
    bytes = List.map(List.keep_if(Str.to_utf8(sequence),|b| b != 10 && b != 13),code)
    packed = List.map(bytes,Num.to_u8)
    first = frequencies(1,packed)
    second = frequencies(2,packed)
    queries = [(3u64,"GGT"),(4,"GGTA"),(6,"GGTATT"),(12,"GGTATTTTAATT"),(18,"GGTATTTTAATTTATAGT")]
    rows = List.map(queries,|pair|
        (width,query) = pair
        table = counts(width,packed)
        number = Dict.get(table,encode(query)) ?? 0
        "${Num.to_str(number)}\t${query}\n",
    )
    Stdout.write!(Str.concat(Str.concat(first,second),Str.join_with(rows,"")))

cumulative : List U8, List F64 -> List (U8,F64)
cumulative = |letters, probabilities|
    (_,pairs) = List.walk(List.map2(letters,probabilities,|a,b| (a,b)),(0f64,[]),|state,pair|
        (total,items) = state
        (letter,probability) = pair
        next = total+probability
        (next,List.append(items,(letter,next))),
    )
    pairs
choose = |value, pairs|
    when pairs is
        [(letter,threshold),.. as rest] -> if value < threshold then letter else choose(value,rest)
        [] -> 116u8
line = |remaining, offset, seed, repeated, distribution, bytes|
    if remaining == 0 then (bytes,offset,seed) else

        value : F64
        value = Num.to_f64(next_seed)/139968.0
        letter = if repeated then get(Str.to_utf8(alu),offset%Str.count_utf8_bytes(alu)) else choose(value,distribution)
        line(remaining-1,offset+1,next_seed,repeated,distribution,List.append(bytes,letter))
emit! = |remaining, offset, seed, repeated, distribution, buffer|
    if remaining == 0 then
        Stdout.write_bytes!(buffer)?
        Ok(seed)
    else
        take = Num.min(60,remaining)
        (bytes,next_offset,next_seed) = line(take,offset,seed,repeated,distribution,buffer)
        next = List.append(bytes,10u8)
        if List.len(next) >= 65536 then
            Stdout.write_bytes!(next)?
            emit!(remaining-take,next_offset,next_seed,repeated,distribution,List.with_capacity(65600))
        else emit!(remaining-take,next_offset,next_seed,repeated,distribution,next)

import pf.Stdout
import pf.Arg exposing [Arg]
argument : List Arg -> U64
argument = |args|
    arg = (List.get(args, 1) |> Result.map_ok(Arg.display)) ?? "0"
    Str.to_u64(arg) ?? 0
get = |items, index|
    when List.get(items,index) is
        Ok(value) -> value
        Err(_) -> crash("index out of bounds")
Big : {negative : Bool, digits : List U64}

base = 4294967296u64
trim_digits = |digits|
    if List.is_empty(digits) then digits else
        if get(digits,List.len(digits)-1) == 0 then trim_digits(List.drop_last(digits,1)) else digits
big : Bool, List U64 -> Big
big = |negative, digits|
    normalized = trim_digits(digits)
    {negative:negative && !List.is_empty(normalized),digits:normalized}
natural = |value|
    if value == 0 then big(Bool.false,[]) else
        if value < base then big(Bool.false,[value]) else big(Bool.false,[value%base,value//base])
compare_digits = |a,b,remaining|
    if remaining == 0 then EQ else
        index = remaining-1
        order = Num.compare(get(a,index),get(b,index))
        if order == EQ then compare_digits(a,b,index) else order
compare_abs = |a,b|
    order = Num.compare(List.len(a),List.len(b))
    if order == EQ then compare_digits(a,b,List.len(a)) else order
add_digits = |a,b,index,carry,output|
    length = Num.max(List.len(a),List.len(b))
    if index >= length then
        if carry == 0 then output else List.append(output,carry)
    else
        av = List.get(a,index) ?? 0
        bv = List.get(b,index) ?? 0
        sum = av+bv+carry
        add_digits(a,b,index+1,sum//base,List.append(output,sum%base))
add_abs = |a,b| add_digits(a,b,0,0,List.with_capacity(Num.max(List.len(a),List.len(b))+1))
subtract_digits = |a,b,index,borrow,output|
    if index >= List.len(a) then trim_digits(output) else
        av = get(a,index)
        bv = (List.get(b,index) ?? 0)+borrow
        digit = if av < bv then av+base-bv else av-bv
        next_borrow = if av < bv then 1u64 else 0u64
        subtract_digits(a,b,index+1,next_borrow,List.append(output,digit))
subtract_abs = |a,b| subtract_digits(a,b,0,0,List.with_capacity(List.len(a)))
big_add : Big, Big -> Big
big_add = |a,b|
    if a.negative == b.negative then big(a.negative,add_abs(a.digits,b.digits)) else
        when compare_abs(a.digits,b.digits) is
            LT -> big(b.negative,subtract_abs(b.digits,a.digits))
            _ -> big(a.negative,subtract_abs(a.digits,b.digits))
big_sub = |a,b| big_add(a,big(!b.negative,b.digits))
multiply_digits = |digits,factor,index,carry,output|
    if index >= List.len(digits) then
        if carry == 0 then output else
            multiply_digits(digits,factor,index,carry//Num.to_u128(base),List.append(output,Num.to_u64(carry%Num.to_u128(base))))
    else
        product = Num.to_u128(get(digits,index))*Num.to_u128(factor)+carry
        digit = Num.to_u64(product%Num.to_u128(base))
        multiply_digits(digits,factor,index+1,product//Num.to_u128(base),List.append(output,digit))
big_mul = |a,factor| big(a.negative,multiply_digits(a.digits,factor,0,0u128,List.with_capacity(List.len(a.digits)+2)))
bit_length = |digits|
    if List.is_empty(digits) then 0u64 else
        top = get(digits,List.len(digits)-1)
        (List.len(digits)-1)*32+64-Num.to_u64(Num.count_leading_zero_bits(top))
shift_bits = |digits,bits|
    scale = Num.shift_left_by(1u64,Num.to_u8(bits%32))
    multiplied = big_mul(big(Bool.false,digits),scale)
    List.concat(List.repeat(0u64,bits//32),multiplied.digits)
power_bit = |bits| List.append(List.repeat(0u64,bits//32),Num.shift_left_by(1u64,Num.to_u8(bits%32)))
divide_abs = |remainder,divisor,quotient|
    if compare_abs(remainder,divisor) == LT then (quotient,remainder) else
        difference = bit_length(remainder)-bit_length(divisor)
        candidate = shift_bits(divisor,difference)
        bits = if compare_abs(candidate,remainder) == GT then difference-1 else difference
        scaled = if bits == difference then candidate else shift_bits(divisor,bits)
        next = subtract_abs(remainder,scaled)
        updated = add_abs(quotient,power_bit(bits))
        divide_abs(next,divisor,updated)
big_floor : Big, Big -> Big
big_floor = |a,b|
    if List.is_empty(b.digits) then crash("division by zero") else
        (quotient,remainder) = divide_abs(a.digits,b.digits,[])
        negative = a.negative != b.negative
        rounded = if negative && !List.is_empty(remainder) then add_abs(quotient,[1u64]) else quotient
        big(negative,rounded)
extract = |factor,q,r,t| big_floor(big_add(big_mul(q,factor),r),t)
spigot = |n,produced,k,q,r,t,pending,rows|
    if produced == n then Str.join_with(rows,"") else
        first = extract(3,q,r,t)
        second = extract(4,q,r,t)
        if first == second then
            digit = List.first(first.digits) ?? 0
            count = produced+1
            line = Str.concat(pending,Num.to_str(digit))
            complete = count%10 == 0 || count == n
            next_rows = if complete then
                padding = Str.repeat(" ",10-Str.count_utf8_bytes(line))
                List.append(rows,"${line}${padding}\t:${Num.to_str(count)}\n")
            else rows
            next_pending = if complete then "" else line
            next_r = big_mul(big_sub(r,big_mul(t,digit)),10)
            next_q = big_mul(q,10)
            spigot(n,count,k,next_q,next_r,t,next_pending,next_rows)
        else
            next_k = k+1
            multiplier = 2*next_k+1
            next_r = big_mul(big_add(r,big_mul(q,2)),multiplier)
            next_q = big_mul(q,next_k)
            next_t = big_mul(t,multiplier)
            spigot(n,produced,next_k,next_q,next_r,next_t,pending,rows)
main! : List Arg => Result {} _
main! = |args|
    Stdout.write!(spigot(argument(args),0,0,natural(1),natural(0),natural(1),"",[]))

import pf.Stdout
import pf.Stdin
import pf.Arg exposing [Arg]
get = |items, index|
    when List.get(items,index) is
        Ok(value) -> value
        Err(_) -> crash("index out of bounds")
Pattern : [Literal U8, Dot, Class Bool (List U8), Sequence (List Pattern), Alternate (List Pattern), Repeat Pattern U64 U64, Begin, End]

escaped = |byte|
    when byte is
        110 -> 10u8
        114 -> 13u8
        116 -> 9u8
        _ -> byte
class_chars = |tokens,index,chars|
    if index >= List.len(tokens) then crash("unterminated character class") else
        value = get(tokens,index)
        if value == 93 then (chars,index+1) else
            (byte,next) = if value == 92 then (escaped(get(tokens,index+1)),index+2) else (value,index+1)
            if next+1 < List.len(tokens) && get(tokens,next) == 45 && get(tokens,next+1) != 93 then
                last = get(tokens,next+1)
                expanded = List.range({start:At(byte),end:At(last)})
                class_chars(tokens,next+2,List.concat(chars,expanded))
            else class_chars(tokens,next,List.append(chars,byte))
parse_alt : List U8, U64 -> (Pattern,U64)
parse_alt = |tokens,index|
    (sequence,next) = parse_sequence(tokens,index,[])
    if next < List.len(tokens) && get(tokens,next) == 124 then
        (rest,after) = parse_alt(tokens,next+1)
        (Alternate([sequence,rest]),after)
    else (sequence,next)
parse_sequence : List U8, U64, List Pattern -> (Pattern,U64)
parse_sequence = |tokens,index,parts|
    if index >= List.len(tokens) then (Sequence(parts),index) else
        token = get(tokens,index)
        if token == 124 || token == 41 then (Sequence(parts),index) else
            (atom,next) = parse_atom(tokens,index)
            (piece,after) = if next < List.len(tokens) then
                when get(tokens,next) is
                    42 -> (Repeat(atom,0,Num.max_u64),next+1)
                    43 -> (Repeat(atom,1,Num.max_u64),next+1)
                    63 -> (Repeat(atom,0,1),next+1)
                    _ -> (atom,next)
            else (atom,next)
            parse_sequence(tokens,after,List.append(parts,piece))
parse_atom : List U8, U64 -> (Pattern,U64)
parse_atom = |tokens,index|
    token = get(tokens,index)
    when token is
        40 ->
            (group,next) = parse_alt(tokens,index+1)
            if next >= List.len(tokens) || get(tokens,next) != 41 then crash("unterminated group") else (group,next+1)
        91 ->
            negated = index+1 < List.len(tokens) && get(tokens,index+1) == 94
            start = if negated then index+2 else index+1
            (chars,next) = class_chars(tokens,start,[])
            (Class(negated,chars),next)
        92 -> (Literal(escaped(get(tokens,index+1))),index+2)
        46 -> (Dot,index+1)
        94 -> (Begin,index+1)
        36 -> (End,index+1)
        _ -> (Literal(token),index+1)
compile = |text|
    tokens = Str.to_utf8(text)
    (pattern,index) = parse_alt(tokens,0)
    if index != List.len(tokens) then crash("unexpected regex token") else pattern
fold_ascii = |byte| if byte >= 65 && byte <= 90 then byte+32 else byte
same_byte = |a,b,insensitive| if insensitive then fold_ascii(a) == fold_ascii(b) else a == b
atom_matches = |pattern,byte,insensitive|
    when pattern is
        Literal(value) -> same_byte(value,byte,insensitive)
        Dot -> byte != 10
        Class(negated,chars) -> negated != List.any(chars,|value| same_byte(value,byte,insensitive))
        _ -> Bool.false
nullable = |pattern|
    when pattern is
        Sequence(parts) -> List.all(parts,nullable)
        Alternate(parts) -> List.any(parts,nullable)
        Repeat(piece,minimum,_) -> minimum == 0 || nullable(piece)
        Begin | End -> Bool.true
        _ -> Bool.false
sequence_starts = |parts,byte,insensitive|
    when parts is
        [] -> Bool.true
        [head,.. as rest] -> can_start(head,byte,insensitive) || (nullable(head) && sequence_starts(rest,byte,insensitive))
can_start = |pattern,byte,insensitive|
    when pattern is
        Sequence(parts) -> sequence_starts(parts,byte,insensitive)
        Alternate(parts) -> List.any(parts,|p| can_start(p,byte,insensitive))
        Repeat(piece,minimum,_) -> minimum == 0 || can_start(piece,byte,insensitive)
        Begin | End -> Bool.true
        _ -> atom_matches(pattern,byte,insensitive)
match_sequence : List Pattern, List U8, U64, Bool -> List U64
match_sequence = |parts,input,position,insensitive|
    when parts is
        [] -> [position]
        [piece,.. as rest] ->
            endings = match_pattern(piece,input,position,insensitive)
            List.join_map(endings,|next| match_sequence(rest,input,next,insensitive))
match_repeat : Pattern, List U8, U64, Bool, U64, U64, U64 -> List U64
match_repeat = |piece,input,position,insensitive,count,minimum,maximum|
    current = if count >= minimum then [position] else []
    if count == maximum then current else
        endings = List.keep_if(match_pattern(piece,input,position,insensitive),|next| next > position)
        advanced = List.join_map(endings,|next| match_repeat(piece,input,next,insensitive,count+1,minimum,maximum))
        List.concat(advanced,current)
match_pattern : Pattern, List U8, U64, Bool -> List U64
match_pattern = |pattern,input,position,insensitive|
    when pattern is
        Sequence(parts) -> match_sequence(parts,input,position,insensitive)
        Alternate(parts) -> List.join_map(parts,|piece| match_pattern(piece,input,position,insensitive))
        Repeat(piece,minimum,maximum) -> match_repeat(piece,input,position,insensitive,0,minimum,maximum)
        Begin -> if position == 0 then [position] else []
        End -> if position == List.len(input) then [position] else []
        _ ->
            if position < List.len(input) && atom_matches(pattern,get(input,position),insensitive) then [position+1] else []
find_next = |pattern,input,position,insensitive|
    if position > List.len(input) then NotFound else
        possible = if position == List.len(input) then nullable(pattern) else can_start(pattern,get(input,position),insensitive)
        ends = if possible then match_pattern(pattern,input,position,insensitive) else []
        when List.first(ends) is
            Ok(last) -> Found(position,last)
            Err(_) -> if position == List.len(input) then NotFound else find_next(pattern,input,position+1,insensitive)
count_matches = |pattern,input,position,insensitive,total|
    when find_next(pattern,input,position,insensitive) is
        NotFound -> total
        Found(first,last) -> count_matches(pattern,input,if first == last then last+1 else last,insensitive,total+1)
replace_from = |pattern,input,replacement,position,output|
    if position > List.len(input) then output else
        when find_next(pattern,input,position,Bool.false) is
            NotFound -> List.concat(output,List.sublist(input,{start:position,len:List.len(input)-position}))
            Found(first,last) ->
                before = List.sublist(input,{start:position,len:first-position})
                joined = List.concat(List.concat(output,before),replacement)
                if first == last && last < List.len(input) then
                    replace_from(pattern,input,replacement,last+1,List.append(joined,get(input,last)))
                else replace_from(pattern,input,replacement,if first == last then last+1 else last,joined)
replace_regex = |pattern,input,replacement| replace_from(pattern,input,Str.to_utf8(replacement),0,List.with_capacity(List.len(input)))
main! : List Arg => Result {} _
main! = |_args|
    raw = Stdin.read_to_end!({})?
    cleaned = replace_regex(compile(">.*\n|\n"),raw,"")
    patterns = [
        "agggtaaa|tttaccct", "[cgt]gggtaaa|tttaccc[acg]", "a[act]ggtaaa|tttacc[agt]t",
        "ag[act]gtaaa|tttac[agt]ct", "agg[act]taaa|ttta[agt]cct", "aggg[acg]aaa|ttt[cgt]ccct",
        "agggt[cgt]aa|tt[acg]accct", "agggta[cgt]a|t[acg]taccct", "agggtaa[cgt]|[acg]ttaccct",
    ]
    rows = List.map(patterns,|text|
        count = count_matches(compile(text),cleaned,0,Bool.true,0u64)
        "${text} ${Num.to_str(count)}\n",
    )
    replacements = [("tHa[Nt]","<4>"),("aND|caN|Ha[DS]|WaS","<3>"),("a[NSt]|BY","<2>"),("<[^>]*>","|"),("\\|[^|][^|]*\\|","-")]
    replaced = List.walk(replacements,cleaned,|bytes,pair|
        (pattern,replacement) = pair
        replace_regex(compile(pattern),bytes,replacement),
    )
    output = Str.join_with(rows,"")
    Stdout.write!("${output}\n${Num.to_str(List.len(raw))}\n${Num.to_str(List.len(cleaned))}\n${Num.to_str(List.len(replaced))}\n")

port module Nbody exposing (main)
import Platform
import Round

port input : ({ n : Int, input : String } -> msg) -> Sub msg
port output : { data : String, done : Bool } -> Cmd msg
type Msg = Start { n : Int, input : String }
main : Program () () Msg
main =
    Platform.worker
        { init = \_ -> ( (), Cmd.none )
        , update = \(Start args) _ -> ( (), output { data = run args.n args.input, done = True } )
        , subscriptions = \_ -> input Start
        }
type alias Body =
    { x : Float, y : Float, z : Float, vx : Float, vy : Float, vz : Float, mass : Float }
solar = 4 * pi * pi
year = 365.24
body x y z vx vy vz mass =
    { x=x, y=y, z=z, vx=vx*year, vy=vy*year, vz=vz*year, mass=mass*solar }
bodies =
    [ body 0 0 0 0 0 0 1
    , body 4.84143144246472090 -1.16032004402742839 -0.103622044471123109 0.00166007664274403694 0.00769901118419740425 -0.0000690460016972063023 0.000954791938424326609
    , body 8.34336671824457987 4.12479856412430479 -0.403523417114321381 -0.00276742510726862411 0.00499852801234917238 0.0000230417297573763929 0.000285885980666130812
    , body 12.8943695621391310 -15.1111514016986312 -0.223307578892655734 0.00296460137564761618 0.00237847173959480950 -0.0000296589568540237556 0.0000436624404335156298
    , body 15.3796971148509165 -25.9193146099879641 0.179258772950371181 0.00268067772490389322 0.00162824170038242295 -0.0000951592254519715870 0.0000515138902046611451
    ]
offset xs =
    let
        momentum = List.foldl (\b p -> {x=p.x+b.vx*b.mass,y=p.y+b.vy*b.mass,z=p.z+b.vz*b.mass}) {x=0,y=0,z=0} xs
    in
    case xs of
        sun::planets -> {sun|vx= -momentum.x/solar,vy= -momentum.y/solar,vz= -momentum.z/solar}::planets
        [] -> []
interactions a rest =
    case rest of
        [] -> (a,[])
        b::tail ->
            let
                dx = a.x-b.x
                dy = a.y-b.y
                dz = a.z-b.z
                square = dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz
                magnitude = 0.01/(square*sqrt square)
                a1 = {a|vx=a.vx-dx*b.mass*magnitude,vy=a.vy-dy*b.mass*magnitude,vz=a.vz-dz*b.mass*magnitude}
                b1 = {b|vx=b.vx+dx*a.mass*magnitude,vy=b.vy+dy*a.mass*magnitude,vz=b.vz+dz*a.mass*magnitude}
                (a2,remaining) = interactions a1 tail
            in
            (a2,b1::remaining)
velocities xs =
    case xs of
        [] -> []
        a::rest ->
            let (updated,remaining) = interactions a rest in
            updated::velocities remaining
advance xs =
    List.map (\b -> {b|x=b.x+0.01*b.vx,y=b.y+0.01*b.vy,z=b.z+0.01*b.vz}) (velocities xs)
energy xs =
    case xs of
        [] -> 0
        a::rest ->
            let
                potential b =
                    let
                        dx = a.x-b.x
                        dy = a.y-b.y
                        dz = a.z-b.z
                    in
                    a.mass*b.mass/sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz)
            in
            0.5*a.mass*(a.vx*a.vx+a.vy*a.vy+a.vz*a.vz)-List.sum(List.map potential rest)+energy rest
steps n xs =
    if n == 0 then xs else steps (n-1) (advance xs)
run n _ =
    let initial = offset bodies in
    Round.round 9 (energy initial)++"\n"++Round.round 9 (energy(steps n initial))++"\n"

port module Spectralnorm exposing (main)
import Platform
import Round

port input : ({ n : Int, input : String } -> msg) -> Sub msg
port output : { data : String, done : Bool } -> Cmd msg
type Msg = Start { n : Int, input : String }
main : Program () () Msg
main =
    Platform.worker
        { init = \_ -> ( (), Cmd.none )
        , update = \(Start args) _ -> ( (), output { data = run args.n args.input, done = True } )
        , subscriptions = \_ -> input Start
        }
coefficient i j =
    1/toFloat(((i+j)*(i+j+1)//2)+i+1)
row transposed i j xs total =
    case xs of
        [] -> total
        x::rest ->
            let a = if transposed then coefficient j i else coefficient i j in
            row transposed i (j+1) rest (total+a*x)
multiply transposed n xs =
    List.map (\i -> row transposed i 0 xs 0) (List.range 0 (n-1))
ata n xs = multiply True n (multiply False n xs)
power k n u v =
    if k == 0 then (u,v) else
        let
            v1 = ata n u
            u1 = ata n v1
        in
        power (k-1) n u1 v1
dot xs ys total =
    case (xs,ys) of
        (x::xr,y::yr) -> dot xr yr (total+x*y)
        _ -> total
run n _ =
    let (u,v) = power 10 n (List.repeat n 1) (List.repeat n 0) in
    Round.round 9 (sqrt(dot u v 0/dot v v 0))++"\n"

port module Fannkuchredux exposing (main)
import Platform
import Round
import Array
port input : ({ n : Int, input : String } -> msg) -> Sub msg
port output : { data : String, done : Bool } -> Cmd msg
type Msg = Start { n : Int, input : String }
main : Program () () Msg
main =
    Platform.worker
        { init = \_ -> ( (), Cmd.none )
        , update = \(Start args) _ -> ( (), output { data = run args.n args.input, done = True } )
        , subscriptions = \_ -> input Start
        }
get i array = Array.get i array |> Maybe.withDefault 0
flips permutation total =
    case permutation of
        0::_ -> total
        first::_ ->
            flips (List.reverse(List.take (first+1) permutation)++List.drop (first+1) permutation) (total+1)
        [] -> total
rotate r permutation =
    case permutation of
        first::rest -> List.take r rest++[first]++List.drop r rest
        [] -> []
prepare r count =
    if r <= 1 then count else prepare (r-1) (Array.set (r-1) r count)
next n r permutation count =
    if r == n then Nothing else
        let
            rotated = rotate r permutation
            remaining = get r count-1
            updated = Array.set r remaining count
        in
        if remaining > 0 then Just(rotated,updated,r) else next n (r+1) rotated updated
enumerate n permutation count r index checksum maximum =
    let
        prepared = prepare r count
        current = flips permutation 0
        nextMaximum = max maximum current
        nextChecksum = checksum+(if modBy 2 index == 0 then current else -current)
    in
    case next n 1 permutation prepared of
        Nothing -> String.fromInt nextChecksum++"\nPfannkuchen("++String.fromInt n++") = "++String.fromInt nextMaximum++"\n"
        Just(perm,counts,rank) -> enumerate n perm counts rank (index+1) nextChecksum nextMaximum
run n _ = enumerate n (List.range 0 (n-1)) (Array.repeat n 0) n 0 0 0

port module Mandelbrot exposing (main)
import Platform
import Task

port input : ({ n : Int, input : String } -> msg) -> Sub msg
port output : { data : String, done : Bool } -> Cmd msg
type Msg = Start { n : Int, input : String } | Continue
continue = Task.perform (always Continue) (Task.succeed ())
send data = output { data=data, done=False }
main : Program () Model Msg
main = Platform.worker {init=\_ -> (initial,Cmd.none),update=update,subscriptions=\_ -> input Start}
type alias Model = {n:Int,row:Int}
initial = {n=0,row=0}
inside remaining cr ci zr zi =
    if zr*zr+zi*zi > 4 then 0 else
        if remaining == 0 then 1 else
            inside (remaining-1) cr ci (zr*zr-zi*zi+cr) (2*zr*zi+ci)
byte n row x bit packed =
    if bit == 8 then Char.fromCode packed else
        let
            value = if x+bit < n then inside 50 (2*toFloat(x+bit)/toFloat n-1.5) (2*toFloat row/toFloat n-1) 0 0 else 0
        in
        byte n row x (bit+1) (packed*2+value)
pixels n row x bytes =
    if x >= n then String.fromList(List.reverse bytes) else pixels n row (x+8) (byte n row x 0 0::bytes)
update msg model =
    case msg of
        Start args -> ({n=args.n,row=0},Cmd.batch[send("P4\n"++String.fromInt args.n++" "++String.fromInt args.n++"\n"),continue])
        Continue ->
            let
                data = pixels model.n model.row 0 []
                finished = model.row+1 == model.n
                next = {model|row=model.row+1}
                command = output {data=data,done=finished}
            in
            (next,if finished then command else Cmd.batch[command,continue])

port module Fasta exposing (main)
import Platform
import Task

port input : ({ n : Int, input : String } -> msg) -> Sub msg
port output : { data : String, done : Bool } -> Cmd msg
type Msg = Start { n : Int, input : String } | Continue
continue = Task.perform (always Continue) (Task.succeed ())
send data = output { data=data, done=False }
main : Program () Model Msg
main = Platform.worker {init=\_ -> (initial,Cmd.none),update=update,subscriptions=\_ -> input Start}
type alias Model = {n:Int,stage:Int,offset:Int,seed:Int}
initial = {n=0,stage=0,offset=0,seed=42}
alu = "GGCCGGGCGCGGTGGCTCACGCCTGTAATCCCAGCACTTTGGGAGGCCGAGGCGGGCGGATCACCTGAGGTCAGGAGTTCGAGACCAGCCTGGCCAACATGGTGAAACCCCGTCTCTACTAAAAATACAAAAATTAGCCGGGCGTGGTGGCGCGCGCCTGTAATCCCAGCTACTCGGGAGGCTGAGGCAGGAGAATCGCTTGAACCCGGGAGGCGGAGGTTGCAGTGAGCCGAGATCGCGCCACTGCACTCCAGCCTGGGCGACAGAGCGAGACTCCGTCTCAAAAA"
cumulative pairs total =
    case pairs of
        [] -> []
        (char,probability)::rest -> (char,total+probability)::cumulative rest (total+probability)
iub = cumulative (List.map2 Tuple.pair (String.toList "acgtBDHKMNRSVWY") [0.27,0.12,0.12,0.27,0.02,0.02,0.02,0.02,0.02,0.02,0.02,0.02,0.02,0.02,0.02]) 0
homo = cumulative (List.map2 Tuple.pair (String.toList "acgt") [0.3029549426680,0.1979883004921,0.1975473066391,0.3015094502008]) 0
choose value pairs =
    case pairs of
        (char,threshold)::rest -> if value < threshold then char else choose value rest
        [] -> 't'
randomLine remaining distribution seed chars =
    if remaining == 0 then (String.fromList(List.reverse chars),seed) else
        let
            next = modBy 139968 (seed*3877+29573)
            value = toFloat next/139968
            char = choose value distribution
        in
        randomLine (remaining-1) distribution next (char::chars)
header stage =
    case stage of
        0 -> ">ONE Homo sapiens alu\n"
        1 -> ">TWO IUB ambiguity codes\n"
        _ -> ">THREE Homo sapiens frequency\n"
block remaining model lines =
    let
        length = model.n*(if model.stage == 0 then 2 else if model.stage == 1 then 3 else 5)
        take = min 60 (length-model.offset)
    in
    if remaining == 0 || take == 0 then (model,String.concat(List.reverse lines)) else
        let
            (line,seed) =
                if model.stage == 0 then
                    let start = modBy (String.length alu) model.offset in
                    (String.slice start (start+take) (alu++alu),model.seed)
                else randomLine take (if model.stage == 1 then iub else homo) model.seed []
            next = {model|offset=model.offset+take,seed=seed}
        in
        block (remaining-1) next ((line++"\n")::lines)
update msg model =
    case msg of
        Start args -> ({initial|n=args.n},Cmd.batch[send(header 0),continue])
        Continue ->
            let
                (next,data) = block 1024 model []
                length = next.n*(if next.stage == 0 then 2 else if next.stage == 1 then 3 else 5)
                finished = next.offset == length
            in
            if finished && next.stage == 2 then (next,output{data=data,done=True}) else
                if finished then
                    let advanced = {next|stage=next.stage+1,offset=0} in
                    (advanced,Cmd.batch[send(data++header advanced.stage),continue])
                else (next,Cmd.batch[send data,continue])

port module Revcomp exposing (main)
import Platform
import Task

port input : ({ n : Int, input : String } -> msg) -> Sub msg
port output : { data : String, done : Bool } -> Cmd msg
type Msg = Start { n : Int, input : String } | Continue
continue = Task.perform (always Continue) (Task.succeed ())
send data = output { data=data, done=False }
main : Program () Model Msg
main = Platform.worker {init=\_ -> (initial,Cmd.none),update=update,subscriptions=\_ -> input Start}
type alias Model = {records:List String,sequence:String,position:Int}
initial = {records=[],sequence="",position=0}
complement char =
    case Char.toUpper char of
        'A' -> 'T'
        'T' -> 'A'
        'U' -> 'A'
        'C' -> 'G'
        'G' -> 'C'
        'M' -> 'K'
        'R' -> 'Y'
        'W' -> 'W'
        'S' -> 'S'
        'Y' -> 'R'
        'K' -> 'M'
        'V' -> 'B'
        'H' -> 'D'
        'D' -> 'H'
        'B' -> 'V'
        _ -> 'N'
start records =
    case records of
        [] -> (initial,output{data="",done=True})
        record::rest ->
            let
                end = String.indexes "\n" record |> List.head |> Maybe.withDefault 0
                name = ">"++String.left end record++"\n"
                sequence = String.dropLeft (end+1) record |> String.replace "\n" "" |> String.replace "\r" "" |> String.reverse |> String.map complement
            in
            ({records=rest,sequence=sequence,position=0},Cmd.batch[send name,continue])
block left sequence position lines =
    if left == 0 || position >= String.length sequence then (position,String.concat(List.reverse lines)) else
        block (left-1) sequence (position+60) ((String.slice position (position+60) sequence++"\n")::lines)
update msg model =
    case msg of
        Start args -> start (List.drop 1 (String.split ">" args.input))
        Continue ->
            if model.position >= String.length model.sequence then start model.records else
                let (position,data) = block 1024 model.sequence model.position [] in
                ({model|position=position},Cmd.batch[send data,continue])

import "core:os"
import "core:strconv"
ALU :: "GGCCGGGCGCGGTGGCTCACGCCTGTAATCCCAGCACTTTGGGAGGCCGAGGCGGGCGGATCACCTGAGGTC" +
    "AGGAGTTCGAGACCAGCCTGGCCAACATGGTGAAACCCCGTCTCTACTAAAAATACAAAAATTAGCCGGGCG" +
    "TGGTGGCGCGCGCCTGTAATCCCAGCTACTCGGGAGGCTGAGGCAGGAGAATCGCTTGAACCCGGGAGGCGG" +
    "AGGTTGCAGTGAGCCGAGATCGCGCCACTGCACTCCAGCCTGGGCGACAGAGCGAGACTCCGTCTCAAAAA"
random_fasta :: proc(out: ^bufio.Writer, length: int, letters: string, probabilities: []f64, seed: ^u32) {
    cumulative: [15]f64
    total := 0.0
    for probability, i in probabilities {
        total += probability
        cumulative[i] = total
    }
    line: [61]u8
    remaining := length
    for remaining > 0 {
        take := min(60, remaining)
        for i in 0..<take {
            seed^ = (seed^*3877 + 29573)%139968
            random := f64(seed^)/139968.0
            choice := 0
            for cumulative[choice] <= random { choice += 1 }
            line[i] = letters[choice]
        }
        line[take] = '\n'
        _, err := bufio.writer_write(out, line[:take+1])
        assert(err == nil)
        remaining -= take
    }
}
main :: proc() {
    n := strconv.parse_int(os.args[1]) or_else 1000
    out: bufio.Writer
    bufio.writer_init(&out, os.to_stream(os.stdout), 65536)
    defer bufio.writer_destroy(&out)
    _, _ = bufio.writer_write_string(&out, ">ONE Homo sapiens alu\n")
    alu := ALU
    line: [61]u8
    offset := 0
    remaining := 2*n
    for remaining > 0 {
        take := min(60, remaining)
        for i in 0..<take { line[i] = alu[(offset+i)%len(alu)] }
        line[take] = '\n'
        _, _ = bufio.writer_write(&out, line[:take+1])
        offset = (offset+take)%len(ALU)
        remaining -= take
    }
    seed: u32 = 42
    _, _ = bufio.writer_write_string(&out, ">TWO IUB ambiguity codes\n")
    random_fasta(&out, 3*n, "acgtBDHKMNRSVWY", []f64{0.27,0.12,0.12,0.27,0.02,0.02,0.02,0.02,0.02,0.02,0.02,0.02,0.02,0.02,0.02}, &seed)
    _, _ = bufio.writer_write_string(&out, ">THREE Homo sapiens frequency\n")
    random_fasta(&out, 5*n, "acgt", []f64{0.3029549426680,0.1979883004921,0.1975473066391,0.3015094502008}, &seed)

}

package main
import "core:bufio"
import "core:os"
import "core:strings"
read_all :: proc() -> [dynamic]u8 {
    bytes := make([dynamic]u8)
    buffer: [65536]u8
    for {
        n, err := os.read(os.stdin, buffer[:])
        if n == 0 { break }
        assert(err == nil)
        append(&bytes, ..buffer[:n])
    }
    return bytes
}
complement :: proc(byte: u8) -> u8 {
    switch byte {
    case 'a','A': return 'T'
    case 't','T','u','U': return 'A'
    case 'c','C': return 'G'
    case 'g','G': return 'C'
    case 'm','M': return 'K'
    case 'r','R': return 'Y'
    case 'w','W': return 'W'
    case 's','S': return 'S'
    case 'y','Y': return 'R'
    case 'k','K': return 'M'
    case 'v','V': return 'B'
    case 'h','H': return 'D'
    case 'd','D': return 'H'
    case 'b','B': return 'V'
    case 'n','N': return 'N'
    }
    panic("invalid DNA")
}
main :: proc() {
    input := read_all()
    defer delete(input)
    out: bufio.Writer
    bufio.writer_init(&out, os.to_stream(os.stdout), 65536)
    defer bufio.writer_destroy(&out)
    record := 0
    for record < len(input) {
        header_end := record + strings.index(transmute(string)input[record:], "\n")
        _, _ = bufio.writer_write(&out, input[record:header_end+1])
        begin := header_end+1
        next := strings.index(transmute(string)input[begin:], ">")
        end := len(input) if next < 0 else begin+next
        used := 0
        for byte in input[begin:end] {
            if byte != '\n' && byte != '\r' {
                input[begin+used] = byte
                used += 1
            }
        }
        line: [61]u8
        column := 0
        for used > 0 {
            used -= 1
            line[column] = complement(input[begin+used])
            column += 1
            if column == 60 || used == 0 {
                line[column] = '\n'
                _, _ = bufio.writer_write(&out, line[:column+1])
                column = 0
            }
        }
        record = end
    }
    assert(bufio.writer_flush(&out) == nil)
}

package main
import "core:fmt"
import "core:os"
import "core:strconv"
foreign import gmp "external:libgmp.10.dylib"
Integer :: struct { allocated, size: i32, limbs: rawptr }
@(default_calling_convention="c", link_prefix="__gmpz_")
foreign gmp {
    init :: proc(x: ^Integer) ---
    clear :: proc(x: ^Integer) ---
    set_ui :: proc(x: ^Integer, value: u64) ---
    mul_ui :: proc(x, a: ^Integer, value: u64) ---
    add :: proc(x,a,b: ^Integer) ---
    sub :: proc(x,a,b: ^Integer) ---
    fdiv_q :: proc(x,a,b: ^Integer) ---
    cmp :: proc(a,b: ^Integer) -> i32 ---
    get_ui :: proc(a: ^Integer) -> u64 ---
}
main :: proc() {
    n := strconv.parse_int(os.args[1]) or_else 30
    values: [7]Integer
    for &value in values { init(&value) }
    defer for &value in values { clear(&value) }
    q := &values[0]
    r := &values[1]
    t := &values[2]
    a := &values[3]
    b := &values[4]
    first := &values[5]
    second := &values[6]
    set_ui(q,1)
    set_ui(t,1)
    k := 0
    produced := 0
    line: [10]u8
    for produced < n {
        mul_ui(a,q,3)
        add(a,a,r)
        fdiv_q(first,a,t)
        mul_ui(b,q,4)
        add(b,b,r)
        fdiv_q(second,b,t)
        if cmp(first,second) == 0 {
            digit := get_ui(first)
            line[produced%10] = u8(digit)+'0'
            produced += 1
            if produced%10 == 0 || produced == n {
                used := 10 if produced%10 == 0 else produced%10
                for i in used..<10 { line[i] = ' ' }
                fmt.printf("%s\t:%d\n", transmute(string)line[:], produced)
            }
            mul_ui(a,t,digit)
            sub(r,r,a)
            mul_ui(r,r,10)
            mul_ui(q,q,10)
        } else {
            k += 1
            multiplier := u64(2*k+1)
            mul_ui(a,q,2)
            add(r,r,a)
            mul_ui(r,r,multiplier)
            mul_ui(q,q,u64(k))
            mul_ui(t,t,multiplier)
        }
    }
}

port module BinarytreesFaithful exposing (main)
import Platform

port input : ({ n : Int, input : String } -> msg) -> Sub msg
port output : { data : String, done : Bool } -> Cmd msg
type Msg = Start { n : Int, input : String }
main : Program () () Msg
main =
    Platform.worker
        { init = \_ -> ( (), Cmd.none )
        , update = \(Start args) _ -> ( (), output { data = run args.n args.input, done = True } )
        , subscriptions = \_ -> input Start
        }
type Tree = Node Int Tree Tree | Empty
build depth identity =
    if depth == 0 then Node identity Empty Empty else
        Node identity (build (depth-1) (2*identity)) (build (depth-1) (2*identity+1))
check tree =
    case tree of
        Empty -> 0
        Node _ left right -> 1+check left+check right
temporary remaining depth total =
    if remaining == 0 then total else
        temporary (remaining-1) depth (total+check(build depth remaining))
depths depth maximum longLived rows =
    if depth > maximum then
        rows++"long lived tree of depth "++String.fromInt maximum++"\t check: "++String.fromInt(check longLived)++"\n"
    else
        let
            iterations = 2^(maximum-depth+4)
            total = temporary iterations depth 0
            line = String.fromInt iterations++"\t trees of depth "++String.fromInt depth++"\t check: "++String.fromInt total++"\n"
        in
        depths (depth+2) maximum longLived (rows++line)
run n _ =
    let
        maximum = max 6 n
        stretch = check(build (maximum+1) 1)
    in
    "stretch tree of depth "++String.fromInt(maximum+1)++"\t check: "++String.fromInt stretch++"\n"++depths 4 maximum (build maximum 1) ""

port module PidigitsOptimized exposing (main)
import Platform
import Integer as I
port input : ({ n : Int, input : String } -> msg) -> Sub msg
port output : { data : String, done : Bool } -> Cmd msg
type Msg = Start { n : Int, input : String }
main : Program () () Msg
main =
    Platform.worker
        { init = \_ -> ( (), Cmd.none )
        , update = \(Start args) _ -> ( (), output { data = run args.n args.input, done = True } )
        , subscriptions = \_ -> input Start
        }
z n = I.fromSafeInt n
extract a q r t =
    I.divBy t (I.add (I.mul q (z a)) r) |> Maybe.withDefault (z 0)
spigot n produced k q r t pending rows =
    if produced == n then String.concat(List.reverse rows) else
        let
            first = extract 3 q r t
            second = extract 4 q r t
        in
        if I.compare first second == EQ then
            let
                digit = I.toInt first
                count = produced+1
                line = pending++String.fromInt digit
                complete = modBy 10 count == 0 || count == n
                nextRows = if complete then (String.padRight 10 ' ' line++"\t:"++String.fromInt count++"\n")::rows else rows
                nextPending = if complete then "" else line
                nextR = I.mul (I.sub r (I.mul t (z digit))) (z 10)
                nextQ = I.mul q (z 10)
            in
            spigot n count k nextQ nextR t nextPending nextRows
        else
            let
                nextK = k+1
                multiplier = z(2*nextK+1)
                nextR = I.mul (I.add r (I.mul q (z 2))) multiplier
                nextQ = I.mul q (z nextK)
                nextT = I.mul t multiplier
            in
            spigot n produced nextK nextQ nextR nextT pending rows
run n _ = spigot n 0 0 (z 1) (z 0) (z 1) "" []

app [main!] {
    pf: platform "https://github.com/roc-lang/basic-cli/releases/download/0.20.0/X73hGh05nNTkDHU06FHC0YfFaQB1pimX7gncRcao5mU.tar.br",
}
import pf.Stdout
import pf.Stdin
import pf.Arg exposing [Arg]
get = |items, index|
    when List.get(items,index) is
        Ok(value) -> value
        Err(_) -> crash("index out of bounds")
Pattern : [Literal U8, Dot, Class Bool (List U8), Sequence (List Pattern), Alternate (List Pattern), Repeat Pattern U64 U64, Begin, End]

escaped = |byte|
    when byte is
        110 -> 10u8
        114 -> 13u8
        116 -> 9u8
        _ -> byte
class_chars = |tokens,index,chars|
    if index >= List.len(tokens) then crash("unterminated character class") else
        value = get(tokens,index)
        if value == 93 then (chars,index+1) else
            (byte,next) = if value == 92 then (escaped(get(tokens,index+1)),index+2) else (value,index+1)
            if next+1 < List.len(tokens) && get(tokens,next) == 45 && get(tokens,next+1) != 93 then
                last = get(tokens,next+1)
                expanded = List.range({start:At(byte),end:At(last)})
                class_chars(tokens,next+2,List.concat(chars,expanded))
            else class_chars(tokens,next,List.append(chars,byte))
parse_alt : List U8, U64 -> (Pattern,U64)
parse_alt = |tokens,index|
    (sequence,next) = parse_sequence(tokens,index,[])
    if next < List.len(tokens) && get(tokens,next) == 124 then
        (rest,after) = parse_alt(tokens,next+1)
        (Alternate([sequence,rest]),after)
    else (sequence,next)
parse_sequence : List U8, U64, List Pattern -> (Pattern,U64)
parse_sequence = |tokens,index,parts|
    if index >= List.len(tokens) then (Sequence(parts),index) else
        token = get(tokens,index)
        if token == 124 || token == 41 then (Sequence(parts),index) else
            (atom,next) = parse_atom(tokens,index)
            (piece,after) = if next < List.len(tokens) then
                when get(tokens,next) is
                    42 -> (Repeat(atom,0,Num.max_u64),next+1)
                    43 -> (Repeat(atom,1,Num.max_u64),next+1)
                    63 -> (Repeat(atom,0,1),next+1)
                    _ -> (atom,next)
            else (atom,next)
            parse_sequence(tokens,after,List.append(parts,piece))
parse_atom : List U8, U64 -> (Pattern,U64)
parse_atom = |tokens,index|
    token = get(tokens,index)
    when token is
        40 ->
            (group,next) = parse_alt(tokens,index+1)
            if next >= List.len(tokens) || get(tokens,next) != 41 then crash("unterminated group") else (group,next+1)
        91 ->
            negated = index+1 < List.len(tokens) && get(tokens,index+1) == 94
            start = if negated then index+2 else index+1
            (chars,next) = class_chars(tokens,start,[])
            (Class(negated,chars),next)
        92 -> (Literal(escaped(get(tokens,index+1))),index+2)
        46 -> (Dot,index+1)
        94 -> (Begin,index+1)
        36 -> (End,index+1)
        _ -> (Literal(token),index+1)
compile = |text|
    tokens = Str.to_utf8(text)
    (pattern,index) = parse_alt(tokens,0)
    if index != List.len(tokens) then crash("unexpected regex token") else pattern
fold_ascii = |byte| if byte >= 65 && byte <= 90 then byte+32 else byte
same_byte = |a,b,insensitive| if insensitive then fold_ascii(a) == fold_ascii(b) else a == b
atom_matches = |pattern,byte,insensitive|
    when pattern is
        Literal(value) -> same_byte(value,byte,insensitive)
        Dot -> byte != 10
        Class(negated,chars) -> negated != List.any(chars,|value| same_byte(value,byte,insensitive))
        _ -> Bool.false
nullable = |pattern|
    when pattern is
        Sequence(parts) -> List.all(parts,nullable)
        Alternate(parts) -> List.any(parts,nullable)
        Repeat(piece,minimum,_) -> minimum == 0 || nullable(piece)
        Begin | End -> Bool.true
        _ -> Bool.false
sequence_starts = |parts,byte,insensitive|
    when parts is
        [] -> Bool.true
        [head,.. as rest] -> can_start(head,byte,insensitive) || (nullable(head) && sequence_starts(rest,byte,insensitive))
can_start = |pattern,byte,insensitive|
    when pattern is
        Sequence(parts) -> sequence_starts(parts,byte,insensitive)
        Alternate(parts) -> List.any(parts,|p| can_start(p,byte,insensitive))
        Repeat(piece,minimum,_) -> minimum == 0 || can_start(piece,byte,insensitive)
        Begin | End -> Bool.true
        _ -> atom_matches(pattern,byte,insensitive)
match_sequence : List Pattern, List U8, U64, Bool -> List U64
match_sequence = |parts,input,position,insensitive|
    when parts is
        [] -> [position]
        [piece,.. as rest] ->
            endings = match_pattern(piece,input,position,insensitive)
            List.join_map(endings,|next| match_sequence(rest,input,next,insensitive))
match_repeat : Pattern, List U8, U64, Bool, U64, U64, U64 -> List U64
match_repeat = |piece,input,position,insensitive,count,minimum,maximum|
    current = if count >= minimum then [position] else []
    if count == maximum then current else
        endings = List.keep_if(match_pattern(piece,input,position,insensitive),|next| next > position)
        advanced = List.join_map(endings,|next| match_repeat(piece,input,next,insensitive,count+1,minimum,maximum))
        List.concat(advanced,current)
match_pattern : Pattern, List U8, U64, Bool -> List U64
match_pattern = |pattern,input,position,insensitive|
    when pattern is
        Sequence(parts) -> match_sequence(parts,input,position,insensitive)
        Alternate(parts) -> List.join_map(parts,|piece| match_pattern(piece,input,position,insensitive))
        Repeat(piece,minimum,maximum) -> match_repeat(piece,input,position,insensitive,0,minimum,maximum)
        Begin -> if position == 0 then [position] else []
        End -> if position == List.len(input) then [position] else []
        _ ->
            if position < List.len(input) && atom_matches(pattern,get(input,position),insensitive) then [position+1] else []
prepare_regex = |pattern,insensitive|
    starts = List.map(List.range({start:At(0u64),end:Before(256u64)}),|byte| can_start(pattern,Num.to_u8(byte),insensitive))
    {pattern:pattern,starts:starts,insensitive:insensitive,at_end:nullable(pattern)}
find_compiled = |compiled,input,position|
    if position > List.len(input) then NotFound else
        possible = if position == List.len(input) then compiled.at_end else (List.get(compiled.starts,Num.to_u64(get(input,position))) ?? Bool.false)
        ends = if possible then match_pattern(compiled.pattern,input,position,compiled.insensitive) else []
        when List.first(ends) is
            Ok(last) -> Found(position,last)
            Err(_) -> if position == List.len(input) then NotFound else find_compiled(compiled,input,position+1)
count_compiled = |compiled,input,position,total|
    when find_compiled(compiled,input,position) is
        NotFound -> total
        Found(first,last) -> count_compiled(compiled,input,if first == last then last+1 else last,total+1)
count_matches = |pattern,input,position,insensitive,total| count_compiled(prepare_regex(pattern,insensitive),input,position,total)
replace_from = |compiled,input,replacement,position,output|
    if position > List.len(input) then output else
        when find_compiled(compiled,input,position) is
            NotFound -> List.concat(output,List.sublist(input,{start:position,len:List.len(input)-position}))
            Found(first,last) ->
                before = List.sublist(input,{start:position,len:first-position})
                joined = List.concat(List.concat(output,before),replacement)
                if first == last && last < List.len(input) then
                    replace_from(compiled,input,replacement,last+1,List.append(joined,get(input,last)))
                else replace_from(compiled,input,replacement,if first == last then last+1 else last,joined)
replace_regex = |pattern,input,replacement| replace_from(prepare_regex(pattern,Bool.false),input,Str.to_utf8(replacement),0,List.with_capacity(List.len(input)))
main! : List Arg => Result {} _
main! = |_args|
    raw = Stdin.read_to_end!({})?
    cleaned = replace_regex(compile(">.*\n|\n"),raw,"")
    patterns = [
        "agggtaaa|tttaccct", "[cgt]gggtaaa|tttaccc[acg]", "a[act]ggtaaa|tttacc[agt]t",
        "ag[act]gtaaa|tttac[agt]ct", "agg[act]taaa|ttta[agt]cct", "aggg[acg]aaa|ttt[cgt]ccct",
        "agggt[cgt]aa|tt[acg]accct", "agggta[cgt]a|t[acg]taccct", "agggtaa[cgt]|[acg]ttaccct",
    ]
    rows = List.map(patterns,|text|
        count = count_matches(compile(text),cleaned,0,Bool.true,0u64)
        "${text} ${Num.to_str(count)}\n",
    )
    replacements = [("tHa[Nt]","<4>"),("aND|caN|Ha[DS]|WaS","<3>"),("a[NSt]|BY","<2>"),("<[^>]*>","|"),("\\|[^|][^|]*\\|","-")]
    replaced = List.walk(replacements,cleaned,|bytes,pair|
        (pattern,replacement) = pair
        replace_regex(compile(pattern),bytes,replacement),
    )
    output = Str.join_with(rows,"")
    Stdout.write!("${output}\n${Num.to_str(List.len(raw))}\n${Num.to_str(List.len(cleaned))}\n${Num.to_str(List.len(replaced))}\n")

port module FannkuchPacked exposing (main)
import Platform
import Array
port input : ({ n : Int, input : String } -> msg) -> Sub msg
port output : { data : String, done : Bool } -> Cmd msg
type Msg = Start { n : Int, input : String }
main : Program () () Msg
main =
    Platform.worker
        { init = \_ -> ( (), Cmd.none )
        , update = \(Start args) _ -> ( (), output { data = run args.n args.input, done = True } )
        , subscriptions = \_ -> input Start
        }
format n checksum maximum = String.fromInt checksum++"\nPfannkuchen("++String.fromInt n++") = "++String.fromInt maximum++"\n"
reverseDigits remaining value reversed place =
    if remaining == 0 then reversed+value*place else
        let
            quotient = floor(toFloat value/16)
            digit = value-quotient*16
        in
        reverseDigits (remaining-1) quotient (reversed*16+digit) (place*16)
packedFlips permutation total =
    let first = permutation-floor(toFloat permutation/16)*16 in
    if first == 0 then total else packedFlips (reverseDigits (first+1) permutation 0 1) (total+1)
preparePacked r count =
    if r <= 1 then count else
        let
            place = 16^(r-1)
            tail = floor(toFloat count/toFloat place)
            previous = tail-floor(toFloat tail/16)*16
        in
        preparePacked (r-1) (count+(r-previous)*place)
packedLoop n permutation count r index checksum maximum advancing =
    if advancing then
        if r == n then format n checksum maximum else
            let
                place = 16^r
                prefix = permutation-floor(toFloat permutation/toFloat(place*16))*(place*16)
                first = permutation-floor(toFloat permutation/16)*16
                rotated = permutation-prefix+floor(toFloat prefix/16)+first*place
                tail = floor(toFloat count/toFloat place)
                remaining = tail-floor(toFloat tail/16)*16-1
                updated = count-place
            in
            if remaining > 0 then packedLoop n rotated updated r index checksum maximum False else
                packedLoop n rotated updated (r+1) index checksum maximum True
    else
        let
            current = packedFlips permutation 0
            prepared = preparePacked r count
            nextChecksum = checksum+(if index == floor(toFloat index/2)*2 then current else -current)
        in
        packedLoop n permutation prepared 1 (index+1) nextChecksum (max maximum current) True
get i array = Array.get i array |> Maybe.withDefault 0
flips permutation total =
    case permutation of
        0::_ -> total
        first::_ -> flips (List.reverse(List.take (first+1) permutation)++List.drop (first+1) permutation) (total+1)
        [] -> total
rotate r permutation =
    case permutation of
        first::rest -> List.take r rest++[first]++List.drop r rest
        [] -> []
prepare r count =
    if r <= 1 then count else prepare (r-1) (Array.set (r-1) r count)
next n r permutation count =
    if r == n then Nothing else
        let
            rotated = rotate r permutation
            remaining = get r count-1
            updated = Array.set r remaining count
        in
        if remaining > 0 then Just(rotated,updated,r) else next n (r+1) rotated updated
enumerate n permutation count r index checksum maximum =
    let
        prepared = prepare r count
        current = flips permutation 0
        nextMaximum = max maximum current
        nextChecksum = checksum+(if modBy 2 index == 0 then current else -current)
    in
    case next n 1 permutation prepared of
        Nothing -> format n nextChecksum nextMaximum
        Just(perm,counts,rank) -> enumerate n perm counts rank (index+1) nextChecksum nextMaximum
run n _ =
    if n <= 13 then
        let permutation = List.foldl (\i packed -> packed+i*16^i) 0 (List.range 0 (n-1)) in
        packedLoop n permutation 0 n 0 0 0 False
    else enumerate n (List.range 0 (n-1)) (Array.repeat n 0) n 0 0 0

port module KnucleotideDict exposing (main)
import Platform
import Round
import Dict
port input : ({ n : Int, input : String } -> msg) -> Sub msg
port output : { data : String, done : Bool } -> Cmd msg
type Msg = Start { n : Int, input : String }
main : Program () () Msg
main =
    Platform.worker
        { init = \_ -> ( (), Cmd.none )
        , update = \(Start args) _ -> ( (), output { data = run args.n args.input, done = True } )
        , subscriptions = \_ -> input Start
        }
code char =
    case char of
        'C' -> 1
        'G' -> 2
        'T' -> 3
        _ -> 0
empty = Dict.empty
increment previous = Just(Maybe.withDefault 0 previous+1)
count width sequence =
    let
        modulus = 4^width
        step char (key,seen,counts) =
            let
                next = modBy modulus (key*4+code char)
                updated = if seen+1 >= width then Dict.update next increment counts else counts
            in
            (next,seen+1,updated)
        (_,_,result) = String.foldl step (0,0,empty) sequence
    in
    result
encode text = String.foldl (\char key -> key*4+code char) 0 text
decode width key =
    if width == 0 then "" else
        decode (width-1) (floor(toFloat key/4))++String.slice (modBy 4 key) (modBy 4 key+1) "ACGT"
compareEntry (ka,ca) (kb,cb) =
    if ca == cb then compare ka kb else compare cb ca
frequencies width sequence =
    let
        counts = count width sequence
        denominator = toFloat(String.length sequence-width+1)
        row (key,total) = decode width key++" "++Round.round 3 (100*toFloat total/denominator)++"\n"
    in
    String.concat(List.map row (List.sortWith compareEntry (Dict.toList counts)))++"\n"
run _ raw =
    let
        start = String.indexes ">THREE" raw |> List.head |> Maybe.withDefault 0
        record = String.dropLeft start raw
        headerEnd = String.indexes "\n" record |> List.head |> Maybe.withDefault 0
        sequence = String.dropLeft (headerEnd+1) record |> String.split ">" |> List.head |> Maybe.withDefault "" |> String.replace "\n" "" |> String.replace "\r" "" |> String.toUpper
        queries = [(3,"GGT"),(4,"GGTA"),(6,"GGTATT"),(12,"GGTATTTTAATT"),(18,"GGTATTTTAATTTATAGT")]
        query (width,text) =
            let counts = count width sequence in
            String.fromInt(Dict.get (encode text) counts |> Maybe.withDefault 0)++"\t"++text++"\n"
    in
    frequencies 1 sequence++frequencies 2 sequence++String.concat(List.map query queries)

// The Computer Language Benchmarks Game
// https://salsa.debian.org/benchmarksgame-team/benchmarksgame/
//
// ported from C# version by Anthony Lloyd

#nowarn "9"

open Microsoft.FSharp.NativeInterop

[<EntryPoint>]
let main args =

    let run n fact taskSize taskId =

        let inline firstPermutation p pp count n idx =
            for i = 0 to n-1 do NativePtr.set p i (int16 i)
            let mutable idx = idx
            for i = n-1 downto 1 do
                let d = idx/NativePtr.get fact i
                NativePtr.set count i d
                if d<>0 then
                    for j = 0 to i do
                        NativePtr.get p j |> NativePtr.set pp j
                    for j = 0 to i do
                        NativePtr.get pp ((j+d) % (i+1)) |> NativePtr.set p j
                    idx <- idx % NativePtr.get fact i

        let inline nextPermutation p count =
            let mutable first = NativePtr.get p 1
            NativePtr.read p |> NativePtr.set p 1
            NativePtr.write p first
            let mutable i = 1
            let mutable c = NativePtr.get count i
            while c>=i do
                NativePtr.set count i 0
                let next = NativePtr.get p 1
                NativePtr.write p next
                for j = 1 to i do NativePtr.get p (j+1) |> NativePtr.set p j
                i <- i+1
                NativePtr.set p i first
                first <- next
                c <- NativePtr.get count i
            NativePtr.set count i (c+1)

        let inline copy p pp n =
            let startL = NativePtr.toNativeInt p |> NativePtr.ofNativeInt<int64>
            let stateL = NativePtr.toNativeInt pp |> NativePtr.ofNativeInt<int64>
            let lengthL = n / 4
            let mutable i = 0
            while i < lengthL do
                NativePtr.get startL i |> NativePtr.set stateL i
                i <- i + 1
            i <- lengthL * 4
            while i < n do
                NativePtr.get p i |> NativePtr.set pp i
                i <- i + 1

        let inline countFlips p pp n =
            let mutable flips = 1
            let mutable first = NativePtr.read p |> int
            if NativePtr.get p first <> 0s then
                copy p pp n
                while NativePtr.get pp first <> 0s do
                    flips <- flips + 1
                    if first > 2 then
                        let mutable lo = 1
                        let mutable hi = first-1
                        while lo<hi do
                            let t = NativePtr.get pp lo
                            NativePtr.get pp hi |> NativePtr.set pp lo
                            NativePtr.set pp hi t
                            lo <- lo+1
                            hi <- hi-1
                    let temp = NativePtr.get pp first
                    NativePtr.set pp first (int16 first)
                    first <- int temp
            flips

        let p = NativePtr.stackalloc<int16> n
        let pp = NativePtr.stackalloc<int16> n
        let count = NativePtr.stackalloc n
        firstPermutation p pp count n (taskId*taskSize)
        let mutable chksum =
            if NativePtr.read p = 0s then 0
            else countFlips p pp n
        let mutable maxflips = chksum
        for i = 1 to taskSize-1 do
            nextPermutation p count
            if NativePtr.read p <> 0s then
                let flips =  countFlips p pp n
                chksum <- chksum + (1-(i%2)*2) * flips
                if flips>maxflips then maxflips <- flips
        chksum, maxflips

    let n = if args.Length=0 then 7 else int args.[0]
    use fact = fixed &(Array.zeroCreate (n+1)).[0]
    NativePtr.write fact 1
    let mutable factn = 1
    for i = 1 to n do
        factn <- factn * i
        NativePtr.set fact i factn

    let chksum, maxFlips =
        let taskSize = factn / System.Environment.ProcessorCount
        Array.init System.Environment.ProcessorCount
            (fun i -> async { return run n fact taskSize i })
        |> Async.Parallel
        |> Async.RunSynchronously
        |> Array.reduce (fun (c1,f1) (c2,f2) -> c1+c2,max f1 f2)
           
    string chksum+"\nPfannkuchen("+string n+") = "+string maxFlips
    |> stdout.WriteLine

    0

// The Computer Language Benchmarks Game
// https://salsa.debian.org/benchmarksgame-team/benchmarksgame/
//
// Contributed by Valentin Kraevskiy
// Multithreaded by Anthony Lloyd
[<Literal>]
let Width = 60
[<Literal>]
let Width1 = 61
[<Literal>]
let LinesPerBlock = 2048

open System

[<EntryPoint>]
let main (args:string []) =
    let n = if Array.isEmpty args then 1000 else Int32.Parse args.[0]
    let out = Console.OpenStandardOutput()
    let blocks = Array.zeroCreate ((8*n-2)/(Width*LinesPerBlock)+3)
    let bytePool = Buffers.ArrayPool.Shared
    let intPool = Buffers.ArrayPool.Shared

    Threading.ThreadPool.QueueUserWorkItem(fun _ ->
        let writeRandom n offset seed (vs:byte[]) (ps:float[]) =
            // cumulative probability
            let mutable total = ps.[0]
            for i = 1 to ps.Length-1 do
                total <- total + ps.[i]
                ps.[i] <- total

            let mutable seed = seed
            let inline rnds l j =
                let a = intPool.Rent (Width*LinesPerBlock+1)
                for i = 0 to l-1 do
                    seed <- (seed * 3877 + 29573) % 139968
                    a.[i] <- seed
                a.[l] <- j
                a

            let inline bytes l (rnds:int[]) =
                let a = bytePool.Rent (Width1*LinesPerBlock)
                let inline lookup probability =
                    let rec search i =
                        if ps.[i]>=probability then i else search (i+1)
                    vs.[search 0]
                for i = 0 to l-1 do
                    a.[1+i+i/Width] <- lookup (float rnds.[i] / 139968.0)
                intPool.Return rnds
                for i = 0 to (l-1)/Width do
                    a.[i*Width1] <- '\n'B
                a

            for i = offset to offset+(n-1)/(Width*LinesPerBlock)-1 do
                Threading.ThreadPool.QueueUserWorkItem(fun o ->
                    let rnds = o :?> int[]
                    blocks.[rnds.[Width*LinesPerBlock]] <-
                    box(bytes (Width*LinesPerBlock) rnds, Width1*LinesPerBlock)
                , rnds (Width*LinesPerBlock) i) |> ignore

            let remaining = (n-1)%(Width*LinesPerBlock)+1
            Threading.ThreadPool.QueueUserWorkItem(fun o ->
                let rnds = o :?> int[]
                blocks.[rnds.[remaining]] <-
                    box(bytes remaining rnds, remaining+(remaining-1)/Width+1)
            , rnds remaining (offset+(n-1)/(Width*LinesPerBlock))) |> ignore
            seed

        let seed = writeRandom (3*n) 0 42 "acgtBDHKMNRSVWY"B
                    [|0.27;0.12;0.12;0.27;0.02;0.02;0.02;
                      0.02;0.02;0.02;0.02;0.02;0.02;0.02;0.02|]

        writeRandom (5*n) ((3*n-1)/(Width*LinesPerBlock)+2) seed "acgt"B
            [|0.3029549426680;0.1979883004921;0.1975473066391;0.3015094502008|]
        |> ignore
    , null) |> ignore

    out.Write(">ONE Homo sapiens alu"B,0,21)
    let table =
        "GGCCGGGCGCGGTGGCTCACGCCTGTAATCCCAGCACTTTGG\
         GAGGCCGAGGCGGGCGGATCACCTGAGGTCAGGAGTTCGAGA\
         CCAGCCTGGCCAACATGGTGAAACCCCGTCTCTACTAAAAAT\
         ACAAAAATTAGCCGGGCGTGGTGGCGCGCGCCTGTAATCCCA\
         GCTACTCGGGAGGCTGAGGCAGGAGAATCGCTTGAACCCGGG\
         AGGCGGAGGTTGCAGTGAGCCGAGATCGCGCCACTGCACTCC\
         AGCCTGGGCGACAGAGCGAGACTCCGTCTCAAAAA"B
    let linesPerBlock = (LinesPerBlock/287+1) * 287
    let repeatedBytes = bytePool.Rent (Width1*linesPerBlock)
    for i = 0 to linesPerBlock*Width-1 do
        repeatedBytes.[1+i+i/Width] <- table.[i%287]
    for i = 0 to (Width*linesPerBlock-1)/Width do
        repeatedBytes.[i*Width1] <- '\n'B
    for _ = 1 to (2*n-1)/(Width*linesPerBlock) do
        out.Write(repeatedBytes, 0, Width1*linesPerBlock)
    let remaining = (2*n-1)%(Width*linesPerBlock)+1
    out.Write(repeatedBytes, 0, remaining+(remaining-1)/Width+1)
    bytePool.Return repeatedBytes
    out.Write("\n>TWO IUB ambiguity codes"B,0,25)

    blocks.[(3*n-1)/(Width*LinesPerBlock)+1] <-
        box("\n>THREE Homo sapiens frequency"B, 30)

    for i = 0 to blocks.Length-1 do
        let mutable t = blocks.[i]
        while isNull t do
            Threading.Thread.Sleep 0
            t <- blocks.[i]
        let bs,l = t :?> byte[] * int
        out.Write(bs,0,l)
        if l=Width1*LinesPerBlock then bytePool.Return bs

    out.WriteByte '\n'B
    0

// The Computer Language Benchmarks Game
// https://salsa.debian.org/benchmarksgame-team/benchmarksgame/
//
// contributed by Valentin Kraevskiy
// modified by Peter Kese

let pi = 3.141592653589793
let daysPerYear = 365.24
let solarMass = 4.0 * pi ** 2.0

type Body = {
    mutable X: float; mutable Y: float; mutable Z: float
    Mass: float
    mutable VX: float; mutable VY: float; mutable VZ: float
}

let planets = [|
    { // jupiter
        X = 4.84143144246472090e+00
        Y = -1.16032004402742839e+00
        Z = -1.03622044471123109e-01
        VX = 1.66007664274403694e-03 * daysPerYear
        VY = 7.69901118419740425e-03 * daysPerYear
        VZ = -6.90460016972063023e-05 * daysPerYear
        Mass = 9.54791938424326609e-04 * solarMass }
    { // saturn
        X = 8.34336671824457987e+00
        Y = 4.12479856412430479e+00
        Z = -4.03523417114321381e-01
        VX = -2.76742510726862411e-03 * daysPerYear
        VY = 4.99852801234917238e-03 * daysPerYear
        VZ = 2.30417297573763929e-05 * daysPerYear
        Mass = 2.85885980666130812e-04 * solarMass }
    { // uranus
        X = 1.28943695621391310e+01
        Y = -1.51111514016986312e+01
        Z = -2.23307578892655734e-01
        VX = 2.96460137564761618e-03 * daysPerYear
        VY = 2.37847173959480950e-03 * daysPerYear
        VZ = -2.96589568540237556e-05 * daysPerYear
        Mass = 4.36624404335156298e-05 * solarMass }
    { // neptune
        X = 1.53796971148509165e+01
        Y = -2.59193146099879641e+01
        Z = 1.79258772950371181e-01
        VX = 2.68067772490389322e-03 * daysPerYear
        VY = 1.62824170038242295e-03 * daysPerYear
        VZ = -9.51592254519715870e-05 * daysPerYear
        Mass = 5.15138902046611451e-05 * solarMass }
|]

let bodies = [
    let svx,svy,svz = // sun momentum
        planets |> Array.fold (fun (x, y, z) body ->
            let c = body.Mass / solarMass
            (x - c * body.VX, y - c * body.VY, z - c * body.VZ))
            (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    yield { X=0.0; Y=0.0; Z=0.0; VX=svx; VY=svy; VZ=svz; Mass=solarMass } // sun
    yield! planets
]

type System = {
    bodies: Body list
    pairs: struct (Body * Body) list
}

let system = {
    bodies=bodies
    pairs=[ for i in 0..bodies.Length-2 do
                for j in i+1..bodies.Length-1 do
                    struct (bodies.[i], bodies.[j]) ]
}

let simulate {bodies=bodies; pairs=pairs} repetitions dt =
    for _ in 1..repetitions do
        // calculate pairwise forces
        for b1,b2 in pairs do
            let dx,dy,dz = b1.X-b2.X, b1.Y-b2.Y, b1.Z-b2.Z
            let dist2 = dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz
            let mag = dt / (dist2 * sqrt dist2)
            let mag2 = b2.Mass * mag
            let mag1 = b1.Mass * mag
            b1.VX <- b1.VX - mag2 * dx
            b1.VY <- b1.VY - mag2 * dy
            b1.VZ <- b1.VZ - mag2 * dz
            b2.VX <- b2.VX + mag1 * dx
            b2.VY <- b2.VY + mag1 * dy
            b2.VZ <- b2.VZ + mag1 * dz
        // move bodies
        for body in bodies do
            body.X <- body.X + dt * body.VX
            body.Y <- body.Y + dt * body.VY
            body.Z <- body.Z + dt * body.VZ

let energy system =
    let ePlanets = system.bodies |> List.fold (fun e b ->
        e + 0.5 * b.Mass * (b.VX*b.VX + b.VY*b.VY + b.VZ*b.VZ)) 0.0
    let ePairs = system.pairs |> List.fold (fun e struct (b1,b2) ->
        let dx,dy,dz = b1.X-b2.X, b1.Y-b2.Y, b1.Z-b2.Z
        let dist = sqrt (dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz)
        e + b1.Mass * b2.Mass / dist) 0.0
    ePlanets - ePairs

[<EntryPoint>]
let main args =
    let repetitions = try int args.[0] with _ -> 20000000
    let e0 = energy system
    simulate system repetitions 0.01
    printf "%.9f\n%.9f\n" e0 (energy system)
    0

extern int private mpzCmp(MPZ& _op1, MPZ& _op2)

[<EntryPoint>]
let main (args:string[]) =

    let mutable tmp1, tmp2, acc, den, num = MPZ(), MPZ(), MPZ(), MPZ(), MPZ()
    
    mpzInit(&tmp1)
    mpzInit(&tmp2)
    mpzInitSetUi(&acc, 0UL)
    mpzInitSetUi(&den, 1UL)
    mpzInitSetUi(&num, 1UL)
    
    let extractDigit nth =
        mpzMulUi(&tmp1, &num, nth)
        mpzAdd(&tmp2, &tmp1, &acc)
        mpzTdivQ(&tmp1, &tmp2, &den)
        mpzGetUi(&tmp1)

    let eliminateDigit d =
        mpzSubmulUi(&acc, &den, d)
        mpzMulUi(&acc, &acc, 10UL)
        mpzMulUi(&num, &num, 10UL)

    let nextTerm k =
        let k2 = k * 2UL + 1UL
        mpzAddmulUi(&acc, &num, 2UL)
        mpzMulUi(&acc, &acc, k2)
        mpzMulUi(&den, &den, k2)
        mpzMulUi(&num, &num, k)

        elif p=12 then
            bytes.[12] <- '1'B
            j <- j + 1
            for k = 13 to j+1 do
                bytes.[k] <- '0'B
        else
            bytes.[p] <- '0'B
            incTotal (p-1)

    while n > 0 do
        k <- k + 1
        nextTerm (uint64 k)
        if mpzCmp(&num, &acc) <= 0 then
            let d = extractDigit 3UL
            if d = extractDigit 4UL then
                bytes.[i] <- byte d + '0'B
                i <- if i=9 then
                        incTotal j
                        out.Write(bytes, 0, j+3)
                        0
                     else i + 1
                eliminateDigit d
                n <- n - 1

    if i > 0 then
        out.Write(bytes, 0, i)
        let suffix = System.Text.Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(System.String(' ',10-i)+"\t:"+args.[0]+"\n")
        out.Write(suffix, 0, suffix.Length)

// The Computer Language Benchmarks Game
// https://salsa.debian.org/benchmarksgame-team/benchmarksgame/

// contributed by Jimmy Tang

open System;
open System.IO
open System.Text.RegularExpressions;

let out = Console.OpenStandardOutput()

let bytemap =
    let lookup = Array.zeroCreate 128
    for a,b in Seq.zip "ACBDGHKMNSRUTWVYacbdghkmnsrutwvy"B "TGVHCDMKNSYAAWBRTGVHCDMKNSYAAWBR"B do lookup.[int a] <- b
    lookup

let revLine (s:string) shift =
    let bytes = Text.Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(s)
    let L = Array.length bytes
    for i in 0..(L - 1) do
        bytes.[i] <- bytemap.[int bytes.[i]]
    for i in 0..(L / 2 - 1) do
        let t = bytes.[i]
        bytes.[i] <- bytes.[L - 1 - i]
        bytes.[L - 1 - i] <- t
    out.Write(bytes, 0, L-shift)
    if shift <> 0 then
        out.WriteByte('\n'B)
        out.Write(bytes, L-shift, shift)

let revcomp title lines =
    printfn "%s" title
    match lines with
    | first::rest ->
        revLine first 0
        let rec loop = function
            | [] -> out.WriteByte('\n'B)
            | (line:string) :: rest ->
                revLine line (String.length first)
                loop rest
        loop rest
    | _ -> ()

let rec run title data =
    match Console.In.ReadLine() with
        | null -> revcomp title data
        | line when line.[0] = '>' ->
            if title <> "" then
                revcomp title data
            run line []
        | line ->
            run title (line::data)
run "" []

// The Computer Language Benchmarks Game
// https://salsa.debian.org/benchmarksgame-team/benchmarksgame/
//
// Based on C# version by Isaac Gouy, The Anh Tran, Alan McGovern
// Contributed by Don Syme
// Small optimisations by Anthony Lloyd

#nowarn "9"

open Microsoft.FSharp.NativeInterop

let approximate n1 u tmp v rbegin rend (barrier:System.Threading.Barrier) =

    let inline multiplyAv v Av A =
        for i = rbegin to rend do
            let mutable sum = A i 0 * NativePtr.read v
            for j = 1 to n1 do
                sum <- sum + A i j * NativePtr.get<float> v j
            NativePtr.set Av i sum

    let inline multiplyatAv v tmp atAv =
        let inline A i j = 1.0 / float((i + j) * (i + j + 1) / 2 + i + 1)
        multiplyAv v tmp A
        barrier.SignalAndWait()
        let inline At i j = A j i
        multiplyAv tmp atAv At
        barrier.SignalAndWait()

    for __ = 0 to 9 do
        multiplyatAv u tmp v
        multiplyatAv v tmp u

    let vbegin = NativePtr.get v rbegin
    let mutable vv = vbegin * vbegin
    let mutable vBv = vbegin * NativePtr.get u rbegin
    for i = rbegin+1 to rend do
        let vi = NativePtr.get v i
        vv <- vv + vi * vi
        vBv <- vBv + vi * NativePtr.get u i
    vBv, vv

[<EntryPoint>]
let main args =
    let n = try int args.[0] with _ -> 2500
    let u = fixed &(Array.create n 1.0).[0]
    let tmp = NativePtr.stackalloc n
    let v = NativePtr.stackalloc n
    let nthread = System.Environment.ProcessorCount
    let barrier = new System.Threading.Barrier(nthread)
    let chunk = n / nthread
    let aps =
        [ for i = 0 to nthread-1 do
            let r1 = i * chunk
            let r2 = if (i < (nthread - 1)) then r1 + chunk - 1 else n-1
            yield async { return approximate (n-1) u tmp v r1 r2 barrier } ]
        |> Async.Parallel
        |> Async.RunSynchronously
    sqrt(Array.sumBy fst aps/Array.sumBy snd aps).ToString("F9")
    |> stdout.WriteLine
    exit 0

open System.Text
open System.Collections.Generic
open System.Threading.Tasks
let sequence = StringBuilder()
let mutable collecting = false
let mutable finished = false
let mutable line = Console.ReadLine()
while line <> null && not finished do
    if line.StartsWith(">") then
        if collecting then finished <- true
        elif line.StartsWith(">THREE") then collecting <- true
    elif collecting then sequence.Append(line.Trim()) |> ignore
    line <- Console.ReadLine()

let code (b:byte) = uint64 ((int b &&& 6) >>> 1)
let pack (s:string) = Seq.fold (fun k c -> (k <<< 2) ||| code(byte c)) 0UL s
let decode key width =
    String(Array.init width (fun i -> "ACTG".[int((key >>> (2*(width-i-1))) &&& 3UL)]))
let counts width =
    let table = Dictionary<uint64,int>()
    let mask = (1UL <<< (2*width))-1UL
    let mutable key = 0UL
    for i in 0 .. dna.Length-1 do
        key <- ((key <<< 2) ||| code dna.[i]) &&& mask
        if i >= width-1 then
            let mutable previous = 0
            table.TryGetValue(key,&previous) |> ignore
            table.[key] <- previous+1
    table
let widths = [|1;2;3;4;6;12;18|]
let jobs = widths |> Array.map (fun width -> Task.Run(fun () -> counts width))
let tables = jobs |> Array.map (fun job -> job.Result)
for i in 0 .. 1 do
    let width = widths.[i]
    tables.[i] |> Seq.sortBy (fun p -> (-p.Value,decode p.Key width))

    let mutable total = 0
    tables.[i+2].TryGetValue(pack queries.[i],&total) |> ignore
